# Unicode Notes

Meeting notes often mix languages. Größe, Café, naïve résumé und 日本語のテキスト
werden unverändert übernommen. Summarize the discussion into short bullet points for
the whole team, keep every decision with its owner and date, and mark open questions
with a question mark so that nothing is lost when the notes are shared across regions.
